claims.assertion: Yazhi says each soul is a memory-defined boundary within shared consciousness; broader awareness includes others, though no level is inherently superior.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her account uses water and ocean analogies.

claims.assertion: She says souls in a loop have each been one another; reincarnation choices are made from an afterlife state retaining ego, with intention shaping lives.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: In Yazhi’s account, between-life experience reflects a soul’s identity, memories, and imaginings, which also influence whether and as whom it reincarnates.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
